@AGENTS.md

## Claude specifics

- The same rules are packaged as an Agent Skill in `skills/doefin-brand/`. Link or copy that folder into `~/.claude/skills/` (or a project's `.claude/skills/`) to load it in any Claude session.
- For visual work, the claude.ai pages in `links.md` (brand book, templates canvas, deck template) can be read with the Artifact tool.
